_readme: Cross-language UCAN chain verification fixture. Consumed by both the TS UCAN library (`@haex-space/ucan`) and the Rust verifier (`walk_prf_chain`, Task 3). W4 PR-3 wire form: payload field is `cap`, value is a CapabilitySet — a sorted array of `{cap, delegatable}` entries. chain[0] = root token (self-signed for OK vectors). chain[chain.length - 1] = leaf token. Each chain[i].signed_token is a complete encoded UCAN JWT. chain[i].proofs is the exact prf array embedded in that token. Errors correspond to Rust `UcanVerifyError` variants introduced in Task 3. Domain tag `haex/space-id/v1` matches Phase-0 space_id derivation. Regenerate via `pnpm run gen:ucan-vectors`; output is byte-deterministic.
